body:
Closes a found-not-fixed gap: one email/password was a single shared identity across every game trusting IDUNA player JWTs (PAPERCRAFT/SHANKPIT/WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS interchangeably). New nullable players.game column, stamped into every JWT at register/login and OAuth. New gameClaimMatches helper: each of the 3 ticket handlers now rejects a mismatched game claim with 403; an absent claim stays unscoped (backward compatible). 21 new tests, go test ./... clean. Live-verified against real prod var/iduna.db -- a papercraft-scoped registration correctly minted a papercraft ticket (200) and was rejected minting a shankpit ticket (403), the exact founder-named scenario ('make sure that account only for papercraft'), reproduced and fixed; test account then deleted. Commit 627633e.

⚓ ☃
title: S241-01: real security fix -- player accounts now scoped per game
